title: Continual Reinforcement Learning Is an Integration Problem
abstract: arXiv:2610.41809v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper presents an opinionated set of ten desiderata intended to inform the design and evaluation of reinforcement-learning agents that learn continually throughout a continuing lifetime. We use these desiderata to examine a representative selection of existing approaches. Progress on individual desiderata is valuable, but the longer-term aim should be to integrate all ten within a single agent. To our knowledge, no published evaluation has yet provided evidence for such an integration. Likewise, the representative benchmarks we review probe different parts of this target, but separate evaluations do not establish that the corresponding properties coexist within one agent throughout a continuing lifetime. As a secondary contribution, we therefore present a compact persistent-world scenario as a playable companion to the desiderata and outline a proposed benchmark that examines a broad range of associated behavioral capabilities toget

translated_title: 持续强化学习是一个整合问题
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一套带有鲜明观点的十条期望标准，旨在为那些在持续生命周期中不断学习的强化学习智能体的设计与评估提供指导。我们利用这些期望标准来审视具有代表性的现有方法。在单个期望标准上取得的进展是有价值的，但更长期的目标应该是将全部十条标准整合到一个单一的智能体中。据我们所知，目前尚无任何已发表的评估为此类整合提供了证据。同样，我们所回顾的代表性基准测试探测的是这一目标的不同部分，但分开的评估并不能证明这些相应属性能够在一个智能体的整个持续生命周期中同时存在。作为次要贡献，我们提出了一个紧凑的持久世界场景作为这些期望标准的可玩配套，并概述了一个提议的基准测试，用于共同考察广泛的相关行为能力。
tldr: 本文提出持续强化学习的关键在于“整合”——即把十条设计与评估期望标准所对应的能力统一到单个智能体中，并为此提出了一个可玩的持久世界场景及综合基准测试。
en_tdlr: This paper argues that continual reinforcement learning is fundamentally an integration problem—requiring all ten proposed desiderata to coexist within a single agent over a continuing lifetime—and introduces a persistent-world scenario and benchmark to evaluate these behavioral capabilities together.
